title: TEDA Donate
description: The full donation page: amount selector, impact tiers, donation goals, trust strip and other ways to give. Add teda/donate-goal and teda/donate-tier children to make goals and amount tiers editable. Phase 1 routes the gift offline (mobile money, bank, prefilled WhatsApp/email); phase 2 turns on live payments from the Customizer with no redesign.
